1,104 reviews. 4.2 stars. And most tourists never leave the beach to see it.

Phu Quoc National Park is a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve covering the majority of the island. Evergreen forest, rare flora, unique oceanic species, and trails that go quiet fast once you leave the entrance.

This is not a half-day stop. Give it a full day. Bring water. Wear shoes you don't mind getting dirty.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
